reworkClosure.P1-1_fail_closed_pdp: Compact fail-closed PEP delivered in all 11 domain services (PdpPort, PdpRequest, PdpDecision with UNKNOWN revocation never treated as not-revoked, UnavailablePdpPort, FailClosedPep with configurable TTL/timeout, PdpActivationGuard refusing startup when dynamic facts are required without a provisioned PDP). learning/learner wire the configured policy-cache-ttl/pdp-timeout; service-template already carried richer PdpPort/PolicyCache/PepGuard with fail-closed tests.
reworkClosure.P1-2_jwt_negatives: Every domain service and service-template gained a decoder-level JWT negative test (local enveloped-JWKS HTTP fixture and Nimbus-signed tokens): valid token accepted; bad signature, expiry, wrong issuer, wrong audience and non-RS256 algorithms rejected.
reworkClosure.P1-3_dynamic_facts: Entry gates keep static verified facts; dynamic-fact consultation is routed through the fail-closed PEP seam and business activation is guarded by PdpActivationGuard (startup refusal without a provisioned PDP). Endpoint-level dynamic consultation remains a documented boundary until the PDP source is provisioned.
reworkClosure.P2-1_dead_config: FailClosedPep consumes the previously dead policy-cache-ttl/pdp-timeout properties in learning/learner; the unused ASSESSMENT_DEFAULT_DENY configuration was removed.
reworkClosure.P3_items: Tenant strictness unified to platform in admin-ops/notification/commerce/analytics token-side resolvers; oversized JWKS (>262144 chars) covered by test in all copies; social/admin-ops wire an explicit JwtDecoder; evidence metadata now matches its filename.

keyFindingFixed.summary: IAM publishes the contract-mandated ApiSuccessEnvelope JWKS ({"data":{"keys":[...]}}), but all 11 domain services and service-template used the stock NimbusJwtDecoder.withJwkSetUri parser, which only accepts a bare RFC 7517 JWK Set. Real IAM access tokens were therefore rejected with 401 by every domain service; only the Gateway had an envelope-aware source.
keyFindingFixed.fix: IamEnvelopedJwkSource copied into every domain service and service-template (envelope and bare-set parsing, cached refresh, fail-closed for empty/invalid/oversized documents), wired through a DefaultJWTProcessor plus JWSVerificationKeySelector decoder. The IAM contract is unchanged; the repair is on the consumer side.

notCovered: phase/consent/rights as live endpoint inputs: the fail-closed PEP seam exists and guards activation, but no business endpoint consults it yet because Phase 1 IAM tokens do not carry those facts and the PDP source is not provisioned.
Endpoint-level fine-grained @PreAuthorize permission matrix is not applied; services enforce verified identity, platform tenant, role/permission presence and per-domain PEP checks.
Service-owned MySQL schemas, Flyway migrations and cross-tenant database guards remain with M2-004.
Only learning-service was exercised as a real process smoke; other services are covered by their security unit suites (JWT negatives, PEP fail-closed, header rejection, converter/resolver negatives).
Notification/commerce provider signature verification and durable outbound delivery remain with their later tasks.
